en: Oak Table

zh: 软垫木椅
en: Cushioned Chair

zh: 储物箱
en: Storage Chest

zh: 木编地垫
en: Woven Wood Mat

zh: 暖光木灯
en: Warm Wooden Lamp

zh: · 室内
en: · Indoors

zh: 起居室
en: Living Room

zh: 先结束当前动作，或点停止。
en: Finish your current action, or press Stop.

zh: 小屋收尾完成后才能入住。
en: Finish the house before moving in.

zh: 你已经在屋外了。
en: You are already outside.

zh: 先放下手里的东西。
en: Put down what you are holding first.

zh: 先布置好已有家具。
en: Place the furniture you already made first.

zh: 先把小屋盖好。
en: Finish building the house first.

zh: 屋外箱子还缺 %s 根木材。
en: The outdoor chest needs %s more wood.

zh: 手里没有家具。
en: You are not holding any furniture.

zh: 这里放不下，或会挡住门和通道。
en: It will not fit here, or it would block a door or walkway.

zh: 家具正在搬运中。
en: The furniture is being carried.

zh: 伙伴正在使用它。
en: A companion is using it.

zh: 伙伴正在使用这个箱子。
en: A companion is using this chest.

zh: 先取出箱子里的材料再搬动。
en: Empty the chest before moving it.

zh: 箱子里没有可取的材料。
en: There are no materials to take from the chest.

zh: 开始啦。
en: Here we go.

zh: 门口暂时走不过去。
en: The doorway is blocked for now.

zh: 屋外门口被挡住了。
en: The outside doorway is blocked.

zh: 找不到这个房间。
en: This room cannot be found.

zh: 走不到小屋门口。
en: The house entrance cannot be reached.

zh: 暂时走不过去，手里的物品会保留。
en: The way is blocked for now. You keep your items.

zh: 进屋啦。
en: Inside at last.

zh: 回到院子了。
en: Back in the yard.

zh: 木材被用完了，手中材料会保留。
en: The wood ran out. You keep your materials.

zh: 材料不够，保留现有材料。
en: Not enough materials. Existing materials are kept.

zh: 位置被占用了，家具还在手里，换个地方放吧。
en: This spot is occupied. You keep the furniture; choose another spot.

zh: 摆好了。
en: Placed.

zh: 箱子里还有材料，先取出来。
en: There are still materials in the chest. Empty it first.

zh: 抱起来了，点房间空地放下。
en: Picked up. Choose an empty spot in the room.

zh: 换好方向了。
en: Turned around.

zh: 材料拿好了，可以搬去其他箱子。
en: Materials picked up. You can carry them to another chest.

zh: 箱子里的材料刚被取走了。
en: The chest's materials were just taken.

zh: 家园工程配置无效。
en: The homestead project settings are invalid.

zh: 工程点地面或通道被占用。
en: The project ground or access route is occupied.

zh: 工程点与农田重叠。
en: The project overlaps a farm.

zh: 工程点被农庄箱子占用。
en: A farm chest occupies the project site.

zh: 工程点被旧宅地或房屋占用。
en: An existing home site or house occupies the project site.

zh: 工程点被树木或箱子占用。
en: A tree or chest occupies the project site.

zh: 工程点被已有设施占用。
en: An existing facility occupies the project site.

zh: 有人正在工程点内，请先让出位置。
en: Someone is at the project site. Clear the space first.

zh: 有已接受的路线经过工程点，请等通道让开。
en: An accepted route crosses the site. Wait until the way is clear.

zh: 工程点内还有未搬走的木材。
en: Unhauled wood remains at the project site.

zh: 花圃已经完工，菜谱已解锁，不会重复扣料。
en: The flowerbed is complete and its recipe unlocked. No materials will be charged again.

zh: 工程计划已取消；已交材料留在工程点，手中物资保留。
en: Project canceled. Delivered materials stay at the site, and carried materials are kept.

zh: 已有本人的家园计划，请明确继续或取消。
en: You already have a homestead plan. Continue or cancel it explicitly.

zh: 先暂停当前安排，再继续这项工程。
en: Pause your current assignment before continuing this project.

zh: 先结束当前工作，再安排家园工程。
en: Finish your current task before arranging a homestead project.

zh: 先放好手中物品，再安排家园工程。
en: Put away what you are holding before starting a homestead project.

zh: 已有投入保留，不覆盖原内容。
en: Existing contributions stay intact.

zh: 走不到工程点，已有投入保留。
en: The project site cannot be reached. Existing contributions are kept.

zh: 木材与作物尚未交齐，不开始施工。
en: Wood and crops are not fully delivered. Construction will not start.

zh: 已有居民在施工。
en: A resident is already building.

zh: 请先存好原有携带物；工程作物须从真实收获箱取出。
en: Store your original carried items first. Project crops must come from real harvest chests.

zh: 仓库没有足够的材料
en: There are not enough materials in storage

zh: 开始按实际物资推进；材料齐备后仍需明确施工。
en: Starting with actual materials. Construction still needs explicit confirmation once funded.

zh: 工程暂停，已交材料和在途物资保留。
en: Project paused. Delivered and in-transit materials are kept.

zh: 工程已暂停，物资保留。
en: The project is paused. Materials are kept.

zh: 工程等待超时，已有投入与携带物保留。
en: Project waiting timed out. Contributions and carried materials are kept.

zh: 已有投入保留。
en: Existing contributions are kept.

zh: 材料未交齐，不施工。
en: Materials are incomplete. Construction will not start.

zh: 材料齐备，请明确开始施工。
en: Materials are ready. Start construction explicitly.

zh: 本次分批交料已完成，投入保留；可以继续交料。
en: This delivery batch is complete. Contributions are kept; you may deliver more.

zh: 先存好无来源凭据的携带物，再继续。
en: Store carried items without a source receipt before continuing.

zh: 箱子空或缺少有权限的木材/收获作物来源，已有投入保留。
en: The chest is empty or has no wood or harvest you may use. Existing contributions are kept.

zh: 原箱子已空、被占用或权限已变，已有投入与携带物保留。
en: The original chest is empty, occupied, or no longer authorized. Contributions and carried materials are kept.

zh: 到箱边时目标已被取走，已有投入保留。
en: The target was taken before arrival. Existing contributions are kept.

zh: 箱子物资已不足或当前交料已足，已有投入保留。
en: Not enough chest stock, or this delivery is already sufficient. Contributions are kept.

zh: 在途物资已变化，停止交付；现有物资保留。
en: In-transit materials changed. Delivery stopped; existing materials are kept.

zh: 原收获箱权限已变，作物留在手里。
en: Harvest chest permissions changed. Crops stay in your hands.

zh: 目标已有足够物资，额外材料留在手里。
en: The target has enough materials. Extra materials stay in your hands.

zh: 花圃完工，已解锁
en: Flowerbed complete. Unlocked:

zh: %s已真实完工，已解锁%s。
en: %s is complete. Unlocked: %s.

zh: 重新进入游戏，请明确继续；物资与施工进度保留。
en: After returning to the game, continue explicitly. Materials and construction progress are kept.

zh: 核对材料
en: Checking Materials

zh: 采集木材
en: Gathering Wood

zh: 搬料到工地
en: Delivering to Site

zh: 施工中
en: Building

zh: 等伙伴完成这一步
en: Waiting for a Companion to Finish This Step

zh: 走出小屋
en: Leaving the House

zh: 收好手中物品
en: Storing Carried Items

zh: 先结束当前工作，再一起建房子。
en: Finish your current task before building together.

zh: 已有建屋计划，请继续、暂停或取消它。
en: A house plan already exists. Continue, pause, or cancel it.

zh: 伙伴已有这座房子的计划，你可以帮忙交料或施工。
en: A companion has a plan for this house. You may help deliver materials or build.

zh: 这座房子已经盖好了，可以进去看看。
en: This house is complete. Step inside.

zh: 先放下家具，再安排建屋。
en: Put down the furniture before planning a house.

zh: 一起把%s盖好：先用现有材料，不够再去采集。
en: Let us finish %s: use existing materials first, then gather anything missing.

zh: 建屋计划已开始，会按实际材料推进到完工。
en: House plan started. Work follows actual materials through completion.

zh: 这个计划现在不需要继续。
en: This plan does not need continuing right now.

zh: 先结束当前动作，再继续计划。
en: Finish your current action before continuing the plan.

zh: 先放下家具。
en: Put down the furniture first.

zh: 继续这座小屋，先看看现在还缺什么。
en: Continuing this home. First, check what is still needed.

zh: 已暂停，材料和进度都留着。
en: Paused. Materials and progress are kept.

zh: 建屋计划已取消；投入和物品会保留。
en: House plan canceled. Contributions and items are kept.

zh: 暂时做不了这一步。
en: This step is blocked for now.

zh: 小屋已完成 %s / 5 阶段，我们接着做。
en: The home has %s / 5 stages complete. Let us continue.

zh: 当前另有工作，建屋计划先暂停。
en: Another task is active. The house plan is paused.

zh: 目标在另一座岛，目前无法前往。
en: The target is on another island and cannot be reached right now.

zh: 先放下手中的家具，再继续建屋。
en: Put down the furniture before continuing the house.

zh: %s已经盖好了。进去看看吧。
en: %s is complete. Step inside.

zh: 重新进入游戏，点继续后再工作。
en: After returning to the game, press Continue before working again.

zh: 先完成当前工作，或点停止。
en: Finish your current task, or press Stop.

zh: 先放好手中的家具或蘑菇。
en: Put down furniture or mushrooms first.

zh: 请选择还没砍倒的树。
en: Choose a tree that has not been felled.

zh: 这棵树有伙伴在处理，请换一棵。
en: A companion is working on this tree. Choose another.

zh: 开始连续伐木并搬运；可随时停止。
en: Starting continuous chopping and hauling. Stop at any time.

zh: 开始采集 %s 棵树，并把木材搬进箱子。
en: Starting work on %s trees and hauling the wood into storage.

zh: 已完整搬运 %s 棵，存入 %s 根木材。%s
en: Fully hauled %s trees and stored %s wood. %s

zh: 没有可达的空箱子，木材还在手里。
en: There is no reachable chest with space. The wood stays in your hands.

zh: 这次指定的采集量完成了。
en: The requested gathering amount is complete.

zh: 箱子满了，地上木材保留着。
en: The chest is full. Dropped wood stays on the ground.

zh: 可达箱子的空间不足一棵树的产量，先腾出位置。
en: Reachable storage cannot hold one tree's yield. Make room first.

zh: 地上的木材暂时走不到，保留在原处。
en: Dropped wood cannot be reached for now. It stays where it is.

zh: 这片区域暂时没有可砍的树。
en: There are no trees ready to cut in this area.

zh: 剩余的树都有伙伴在处理，先停在这里。
en: Companions are working on all remaining trees. Stopping here.

zh: 剩余树木暂时走不到，先停在这里。
en: The remaining trees cannot be reached. Stopping here.

zh: 连续伐木：已搬完 %s 棵，存入 %s 根木材。
en: Wood gathering: fully hauled %s trees and stored %s wood.
